def calc_mse_loss(loss, x, y):
    """
    Calculate mse loss.
    """
    # Compute loss
    loss_mse = torch.mean((x-y)**2)
    loss["loss"] += loss_mse
    loss["loss_mse"] = loss_mse
    return loss
